notes.title: Trading cards are now available for Toy Tinker Simulator
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are delighted to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now available on Steam, along with other exclusive rewards:

• Collect Trading cards by playing the game
• Win various badges
• Unlock backgrounds for your profile
• Use unique emoticons


Have fun!

notes.title: CHECK OUT OUR NEXT GAME
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that our new game, Smart Factory Tycoon, is on Steam now!

Smart Factory Tycoon is a tycoon management game about running your dream factory with robots. Design your dream factory, plan all steps of production, research new technologies and become a tycoon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755300/Smart_Factory_Tycoon/
